Acme Bug Bounty Program

Our bug bounty program was launched on September 5, 2026. We welcome reports from security researchers. Please report any suspected security vulnerability to security@acme-corp.com. We will respond within 3 business days.

We offer monetary rewards ranging up to $10,000 for qualifying vulnerabilities. Bounties start at $100.

We operate under a safe harbor policy: we will not pursue legal action against researchers acting in good faith. Please do not perform denial of service testing.

In Scope

  • *.acme-corp.com
  • api.acme-corp.com — REST API endpoints
  • Android application (com.acme.app)
  • iOS application

Out of Scope

  • Third-party services
  • Social engineering
  • Physical attacks
